items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Then the guy say, "Is anything going on backstage?" He say, "No!" He say, "Ain't nothing going on in front, either!" You know. Well, that's the same way with that music. If people really heard the music, took away the smoke, the drums beating all loud and bam-ditty­ bam, and just played the melody, and they heard that, they'd wanna kill somebody. You know. Because it's sad. Sadder than McKinley's funeral!
